description: Use this AFTER prepare_quote_request returns ready_to_submit=true for a pet insurance quote. Display the review and exact consent question in an interactive card inside ChatGPT, without opening AssurancesLabs. The user can explicitly accept or refuse. This tool only renders UI, it never creates a lead or contacts an insurer. A model-reported click is not signed proof of consent.
name: render_pet_quote_consent
